items.followUp: State the first condition of equilibrium and write its formula.

rubric.why: The second condition requires the turning effects in the two directions to balance.
rubric.description: States that the sum of clockwise moments equals the sum of anticlockwise moments about the same point.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that clockwise and anticlockwise moments are equal.

rubric.why: This formula states that the resultant moment on a body in equilibrium is zero.
rubric.description: Gives a correct formula for the second condition of equilibrium.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a correct zero-resultant-moment formula.

modelAnswer: The second condition of equilibrium is that the sum of clockwise moments about any point equals the sum of anticlockwise moments about the same point.
Formula: Σ clockwise moments = Σ anticlockwise moments, or Στ = 0.
